scripts.deploy: pnpm run d1:migrate:remote && cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy
scripts.d1:migrate:local: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply USER_DB --local
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: cross-env WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply USER_DB --remote
scripts.r2:cors:apply: wrangler r2 bucket cors set picbind-bucket --file r2-cors.json
